examples.japanese: {野党|やとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}した→反対：01497_hantai⟧。

examples.english: To listen to the opposition's opinion.

examples.japanese: {野党|やとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法案|ほうあん}→法案：09758_houan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}している→反対：01497_hantai⟧。
examples.english: The opposition is strongly opposing the ruling party's bill.

notes:
{野党|やとう} means opposition party - political parties not currently in power.

WORD FORMATION:
{野|や} (field/outside) + {党|とう} (party) - literally "parties in the field" (outside of power)

KEY POLITICAL TERMS:
- ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧: ruling party (in power)
- {野党|やとう}: opposition party (not in power)
- ⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧: political party (general term)
- ⟦{連立|れんりつ}→連立：14492_renritsu⟧: coalition

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {野党|やとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対：01497_hantai⟧: the opposition opposes
- {野党|やとう}⟦{側|がわ}→〜側：03090_gawa⟧: the opposition side
- {野党|やとう}⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧: opposition party member

NOTE:
In Japanese politics, the ruling party (⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧) has historically been the LDP (⟦{自民党|じみんとう}→自民党：28140_jimintou⟧), with various opposition parties.
